node.title: v13 Q/BC/SP interface (adapter taxonomy)
node.statement: ADAPTER (v13 raw, upstream: przchojecki/rs-mca towards-prize.md (2026-07-01 revision) + cap25 v13 raw notes): the safe-side residual decomposes first-match as paid_tangent + paid_quotient + paid_extension + Q + BC + SP + named residuals, where Q = prefix/quotient flatness, BC = base-field-normalized split-pencil census, SP = primitive shift-pair control. PROVED as a taxonomy: the classes are defined first-match with a named-residual catch-all, so the decomposition is exhaustive by construction; the content lives in the class bounds (our existing strata), not the partition. This is the translation bridge: Q ~ our quotient/strip lane, BC ~ our SPI/XR aperiodic census, SP ~ our moment-trade/shift-pair discoveries.
